newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar in tight range, crosses bump up volume.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar in tight range, crosses bump up volume.

text.p: Volume figures made sugar look more active in morning trade, after a series of quiet days.
But volume was well bumped up by crosses, traders said.
Sugar traded in a tight range. By 1030 GMT, front month August was unchanged at $320.20.
Volume on August was 311 lots of a total 1,113.
December was most active, with 348 lots. It most recently traded at $306.50, 10 cents higher.
Crosses accounted for more than 600 lots of the recorded volume, according to one trader.
There was no fundamental news to drive the market, he said. "It's not being driven. It's not going anywhere," he said.
"There's just a lack of interest," he said.
In New York on Tuesday, sugar futures settled firmer and at the day's highs amid a late round of local shortcovering, traders said.
New York volume was thin as players extended a long Memorial Day weekend.
